Name: Spacious Greenhouse
Author: mintgal
Description:
simple greenhouse map edit that makes it bigger, to fit 6 iridium sprinklers, and also changes the back wall to be glass so you have a prettier view. the view will update based on the season. there is also a version which has a cellar (however casks will not work there).

requires content patcher; to install, download the version you want and extract to Mods folder.
